column1: # Original generic unit rules prompted by an external benchmark coverage audit.
# Values retain exact magnitude; no unit conversion or corpus-specific exact rules.
# Explicit degree mark disambiguates temperature from contextual building F.
# Per-forms and units the external English sample leaves unnormalized today.
# The lowercase spelling maps to the declared mL unit rather than a second id.
# Symbols that reached the synthesizer as written. A scale keeps winning over the
# bare degree because the longest declared suffix matches first.
# Unit abbreviations the sweep found unnormalized. A single letter (A, V, B,
# t, s, l) stays undeclared: that is the ambiguous identifier shape.
# Written variants of existing units (AI Hub 159: Kcal/kal 17/17, kw 8/9).
# Energy, speed per second, specific absorption rate and cubic centimetres.
# Unit symbols from the 표준국어대사전 survey (2026-10-04): prefixed SI units, squared unit
# characters (U+3380..U+33DF) and the fine-dust concentration ㎍/㎥. V, A, J, MJ and GJ need a cue word.
# Squared units written with a plain 2 and pounds (the English references: km2
# square kilometers 19 of 19, lbs pounds 29 of 29; 2026-10-07).
# Abbreviations in the owner's evaluation sets (2026-10-14).
# Owner evaluation sets, phase 4 (2026-10-14): 4.6 in. inches (67¢ is in languages/en-US/pack.c)
